note: Attacker-controlled TLS record bytes (ServerHello then Certificate handshake) are copied into the TLS reassembly buffer for later parsing.
The buffered TLS payload is handed to the TLS block parser.
The parser iterates over TLS handshake blocks; the Certificate block (type 0x0b) is dispatched to processCertificate.
The 20-byte certificate containing the subjectAltName extension is passed to the certificate element parser.

note: The subjectAltName extension contains an ipAddress general name (0x87) with len=2 (not 4), so the dNSName[256] buffer is never initialized.
cleanupServerName reads and lowercases len=2 bytes of the uninitialized dNSName buffer, propagating uninitialized bytes.
ndpi_is_printable_string reads the uninitialized dNSName bytes, triggering the MemorySanitizer Use-of-uninitialized-value report.
